browse.login.instructions.value: On your phone or computer, open Jellyfin, go to Quick Connect in your user settings and enter this code. You can also scan the code to open that page.

browse.auth.tls_untrusted.value: This TV doesn't trust your server's security certificate. Update FinNative and try again.
browse.auth.tls_untrusted.description: Reason line on Who's watching or the sign-in read-out when the server answered over HTTPS but its certificate chain could not be verified against this television's trusted certificate authorities (X509 verify result 2, 18, 19, 20 or 21); it is NOT the wrong-clock case, which has its own line. The sentence names the remedy that exists in the app: results 2, 20 and 21 on a plex.direct name mean an out-of-date certificate store, which an update answers with newer bundled public roots; 18 and 19 mean the server presented its own root, which only the server's owner can fix. No placeholders. Sits in a two-line reason slot on the sign-in read-out and one centred line on the picker; keep the whole sentence at 125 characters or fewer.

browse.jf.no_server.value: No Jellyfin server answered on this network. Use Manual sign-in to enter its address.
browse.jf.no_server.description: FinNative sign-in failure: LAN discovery found no Jellyfin server; points at the Manual sign-in button

browse.jf.unreachable.value: Couldn’t reach your Jellyfin server. Check the address and that the server is on.
browse.jf.unreachable.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server address did not answer

browse.jf.not_jellyfin.value: There’s no Jellyfin server at that address.
browse.jf.not_jellyfin.description: FinNative sign-in failure: something answered at the address but it is not Jellyfin

browse.jf.wrong_password.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server rejected the username and password

browse.jf.sign_in_failed.value: Your Jellyfin server didn’t accept the sign-in. Try again.
browse.jf.sign_in_failed.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server answered the password sign-in with an error

browse.jf.quick_connect_failed.value: Your Jellyfin server didn’t start Quick Connect. Try again.
browse.jf.quick_connect_failed.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server would not start Quick Connect

browse.jf.quick_connect_off.value: Quick Connect is off on your Jellyfin server. Turn it on in Dashboard, General, or use Manual sign-in.
browse.jf.quick_connect_off.description: FinNative sign-in failure: Quick Connect is disabled on the server; names the Jellyfin dashboard page and the Manual sign-in button

browse.jf.bad_address.value: This Jellyfin server’s address can’t be used.
browse.jf.bad_address.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server address cannot be turned into a connection

browse.jf.plaintext_name.value: This server isn’t encrypted, so it can only be used at its IP address on your home network, like http://192.168.1.20:8096. Or use its https:// address.
browse.jf.plaintext_name.description: FinNative sign-in failure: the server address is plain http but is a name or a public address, which a release build will not send a password to unencrypted; gives an example private IP address with Jellyfin's default port

browse.jf.manual.description: FinNative sign-in page button: opens the form to type a server address, username and password

browse.jf.next_up.description: FinNative shelf title: the next unwatched episode of each show being watched (Jellyfin's Next Up)

browse.jf.more_like_this.description: FinNative shelf title on an item's page: titles Jellyfin finds similar to this one

browse.jf.form_copy.value: Enter your server’s address, then sign in with your username and password, or with Quick Connect.
browse.jf.form_copy.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: the paragraph under the title

browse.jf.server.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: label of the server address field

browse.jf.server_example.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: example shown in the empty server address field; keep the two addresses unchanged

browse.jf.username.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: label of the username field

browse.jf.password.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: label of the password field

browse.jf.quick_connect.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: button that signs in to the typed server by Quick Connect instead of a password

browse.jf.need_server.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: shown when Sign in or Quick Connect is pressed with no server address

browse.jf.need_username.description: FinNative manual sign-in form: shown when Sign in is pressed with no username

browse.jf.favorite_add.description: FinNative item menu row and detail-page control: makes this movie, show or episode one of the user's Jellyfin favorites

browse.jf.favorite_remove.description: FinNative item menu row and detail-page control: takes this movie, show or episode off the user's Jellyfin favorites

browse.jf.favorites.description: FinNative Home shelf title: the movies, shows and episodes the user marked as Jellyfin favorites

browse.auth.sign_in_again.value: The server no longer accepts {profile}’s sign-in. Sign in again with Add user.
